skill_name: Given the story of a person’s life, describe the effect they had on their environment.
workflow: John's inventions had a profound effect on his community. By providing these tools to his neighbors and friends, he helped them to become more self-sufficient and lowered their cost of living. He also encouraged them to value education, as he was a self-taught inventor. John improved access to technology and fostered a sense of pride and cooperation among the members of his community, helping them to work together to create a better future for all.
